concerns.text: FR-004 (Multivariate Linear Regression) and SC-002 (Significant Regression Coefficient) lack implementation tasks. T023 is marked incomplete/missing, and no task exists to implement the regression logic in code/analysis.py using statsmodels with the specified predictors (shannon_index, Age, Sex, BMI, DQS).

SC-002 (Regression Coefficient Significance) and SC-003 (FDR Correction) lack output generation tasks. T027 (Save regression summary) and T026 (Save correlation results) are marked incomplete, leaving no mechanism to produce the required CSV artifacts for validation.

SC-003 (FDR Correction) and FR-005 (Apply FDR Correction) lack implementation tasks. T032 (FDR Correction) and T033 (Save q-values) are marked incomplete, preventing the project from satisfying the requirement to report q-values < 0.05.

FR-008 (DQS Calculation) and FR-010 (DQS Validation) lack critical implementation tasks. T014a (DQS existence check raising fatal error) is marked incomplete, and T015 (Save cleaned dataset) is incomplete, blocking the downstream regression and analysis tasks.

Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and Principle II (Verified Accuracy) are unsupported by tasks. T054 (Document data access) is marked incomplete, meaning the pipeline cannot be run on a fresh environment without undocumented manual intervention, violating the 'Reproducibility' requirement.

Constitution Principle VI (Statistical Rigor) requires validation of residual normality for multivariate regression. T025b (Residual Normality Validation) is marked incomplete, leaving the project unable to satisfy the non-negotiable constitutional requirement for the Secondary Path analysis.

T045, T046, T047 are tagged as 'Spec Override' tasks to amend spec.md. However, the current spec.md (v1.1) still contains the original text for FR-003, FR-007, and SC-001. The tasks describe the *intent* to fix the spec, but the spec itself remains unamended in the provided artifact, creating a state where the tasks contradict the active spec text.
